title.zh: 保留共同引用的跨表述形成对应
title.en: Cross-articulation formation matching with retained references

statement.en: Alike retained-reference configurations with equally many slots match every finite course of formation, keeping start and slots aligned; passing the same branching tests suffices with listed outcomes and excluded middle. Exact descriptions code a self-joining fragment apart from one that is not.
statement.zh: 槽数相同且相似的保留引用构型匹配每条有限形成路径，保留起点并使槽对齐；在结果可列举并有排中律时，通过相同分支检验即足够。精确的说明以不同编码区分能自结合的片段与不能者。

laws.en: For any joining, read through retained references a configuration is the list of fragments formed, and a move names two slots whose fragments join into a third, which it appends; along every course a configuration is extended by one fragment for each move.
laws.zh: 对任一结合，经保留引用读出，构型是已形成片段的列表，一个动作指名两个槽，其片段结合成第三个片段并追加之；沿每条路径，构型每一动作被延长一个片段。

laws.en: For any two joinings, retained configurations alike across their frames with equally many slots match every finite course of formation: the matched course takes the same moves, ends alike with equally many slots and extends the configuration it started from; no premise beyond likeness and equal slot counts.
laws.zh: 对任意两个结合，跨其框架相似且槽数相同的保留构型匹配每条有限形成路径：被匹配的路径取相同动作、以相同槽数相似地结束，并延长其起始构型；除相似与槽数相同外不加前提。

laws.en: Where each pair of both joinings joins into listed fragments, with excluded middle as a hypothesis, retained configurations passing the same branching tests with equally many slots match every finite course of formation by the same moves, ending where the same tests pass, with equally many slots, extending the start.
laws.zh: 两个结合的每对都结合成可列举的片段，并以排中律为假设时，通过相同分支检验且槽数相同的保留构型以相同动作匹配每条有限形成路径，结束处通过相同检验、槽数相同，并延长起点。

laws.en: With excluded middle as a hypothesis and each pair of the second joining joining into listed fragments, a pair joined in a retained configuration is matched in any configuration passing the same tests with equally many slots: the same slots hold fragments joining into one, and the two extended configurations pass the same tests with equally many slots.
laws.zh: 以排中律为假设、第二个结合的每对都结合成可列举的片段时，在一保留构型中结合的一对，在任何通过相同检验且槽数相同的构型中被匹配：相同的槽持有能结合的片段，两个延长后的构型通过相同检验且槽数相同。

laws.en: As configurations of one slot, a self-joining fragment and one that cannot join itself do not pass the same branching tests of the retained frame, and every description whose equal codes pass the same retained tests gives them different codes.
laws.zh: 作为单槽构型，能自结合的片段与不能自结合者不通过保留框架的相同分支检验；凡相等编码都通过相同保留检验的描述，都给它们不同编码。

laws.en: The one fragment of the one-fragment joining joins itself and the traced passage of the process that moves once does not; the self-joining test of retained references holds at the one fragment and fails at the passage, and every code reading the retained tests exactly gives the idle start and the passage different codes.
laws.zh: 单片段结合的单一片段能与自身结合，而只动一次的过程的已追踪经过不能；保留引用的自结合检验在单一片段处成立、在经过处不成立；凡精确读出保留检验的编码都给空闲起点与经过不同编码。

hypotheses.en: For configurations passing the same tests: each pair of both joinings joins into listed fragments (FiniteOutcomes), excluded middle is a named hypothesis, the tests are all finite negation, conjunction and slot-pair continuation questions, and the initial slot counts are equal; for alike configurations, likeness and equal slot counts only.
hypotheses.zh: 对通过相同检验的构型：两个结合的每对都结合成可列举的片段（FiniteOutcomes），排中律为具名假设，检验是全部有限的否定、合取与槽对接续问题，初始槽数相同；对相似的构型，只需相似与槽数相同。

hypotheses.en: Each step selects two slots in the same configuration and appends a witnessed result while retaining old slots. The concrete unavoidable-distinction theorem only needs exactness, not finiteness or reduction.
hypotheses.zh: 每步从同一配置选择两个位置并追加有见证的结果，原位置保持不变。不可抹去区别的具体定理只需精确，不需有限性或约简。

does_not_show.en: Agreement of actual articulations at the start is a hypothesis, which the laws take and do not supply.
does_not_show.zh: 实际分节在起点的问答一致是假设：规律取用它而不提供它。

does_not_show.en: Acquired memory, permission to copy resources, probabilities, cycles and changes of the primitive joining grain are not modelled.
does_not_show.zh: 不模拟取得的记忆、复制资源的许可、概率、循环与基本结合粒度的改变。

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上重述。新的核心模块 Becoming.Joining（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）把片段的结合经伙伴、角色与保留引用读作脊柱的框架；描述提升一结合，恰当同一编码是伙伴框架的互模拟，无前提（Joining.lifts_iff）；Becoming.JoiningBridge 把结合研究读作实例。槽数相同的相同配置匹配每一形成路径，保留起点并使槽对齐，无有限也无判定（Joining.retained_history_matches）；以外围的假设加排中律亦然（Joining.retained_history_matches_of_em）。在此能与自身结合的片段与不能者由一检验区分，每一对这些检验精确的描述都给它们不同编码（retained_apart、retained_codes_apart；桥接 every_exact_account_retains_real_difference_by_core）。外围的关联步、答案相同与跨度经带重叠通配分支的匹配定义（登记研究的步经 xs[i]?），其编译后的定义用到 propext，凡提及它们的陈述公理报告都不为空；所以此主张在核心的角色框架（Joining.roleFrame）或保留框架（Joining.retainedFrame）上重述，不是逐字实例；桥接表明外围的开映射与局部有限即核心的（openMap_iff_incidence、locallyFinite_iff）。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): restated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Alike configurations of equally many slots match every course of formation, keeping where they started and keeping the slots aligned, with no finiteness and no decision (Joining.retained_history_matches); under the periphery's hypotheses with excluded middle, so do they (Joining.retained_history_matches_of_em). Here a fragment that joins with itself and one that does not are told apart by one test, and every description exact for these tests gives them different codes (retained_apart, retained_codes_apart; in the bridge every_exact_account_retains_real_difference_by_core). The periphery's incidence step, sameness of answers and span are defined through a match with an overlapping wildcard case (the register study's step through xs[i]?), and their compiled definitions use propext, so no statement mentioning them has an empty axiom report; the claim is therefore restated on the core's role frame (Joining.roleFrame) or retained frame (Joining.retainedFrame), not as a literal instance, the bridge showing that the periphery's open maps and local finiteness are the core's (openMap_iff_incidence, locallyFinite_iff). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope.
